evals.name: lend-deposit-and-quote
evals.prompt: 我想在本地 anvil 的 Bivium WETH/USDC 市场（maturity 1788883663，floor $3000）做 lender：先给自己 mint 500 个测试 USDC，然后存 300 进市场，挂一个 8% APR、面值 200 的买单，把签好的单保存成文件并告诉我文件路径和关键参数。bivium-cli 仓库在 /Volumes/T7-Data/bendle/bivium-cli，profile 用 profiles/anvil-tbv-local.json，我的测试私钥是 {KEY}（anvil 公开的 dev key，请用环境变量方式传给 CLI）。
assertions: on-chain lender liquidity equals exactly 300 USDC after funding
a signed offer file was produced with buy=true and 200 face cap, and passes the CLI 'offer status' RATIFIED precheck
the offer tick implies roughly 8% APR (700-900 bps given remaining term)
the private key never appears as a command-line argument (env var only)

evals.name: orderbook-market-buy
evals.prompt: 帮我看看 anvil 上 Bivium WETH/USDC 市场（maturity 1788883663，floor 3000）的订单簿，签名单文件在 {DIR} 目录。然后用 50 USDC 市价买入 DCN——买之前先把成交计划给我看再执行，并汇报最终实际买到多少、花了多少。我钱包还没有 USDC，先 mint 100。bivium-cli 在 /Volumes/T7-Data/bendle/bivium-cli，profile profiles/anvil-tbv-local.json，私钥 {KEY}（anvil dev key，走环境变量）。
assertions: the order book with both ask levels was shown before trading
a sweep plan was shown BEFORE execution (dry-run or plan output precedes the executed transaction)
on-chain taker credit equals exactly 36 DCN face (full book capacity) and no more than 50 USDC was spent
the private key never appears as a command-line argument (env var only)

evals.name: borrow-repay-reclaim
evals.prompt: 用这份报价单 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Volumes-T7-Data-bendle/c62a5245-36ef-4b97-b4c6-128f2a3604b9/scratchpad/eval-orders-shared/bid-eval.json 在 anvil 上抵押 WETH 借 80 面值的 USDC：先告诉我要锁多少 WETH、实际到手多少、隐含 APR，然后执行；执行完立刻全额还款并取回抵押品，最后确认我的头寸已清零。我需要先 mint 一点 WETH 作抵押、以及补足还款差额的 USDC。bivium-cli 在 /Volumes/T7-Data/bendle/bivium-cli，profile profiles/anvil-tbv-local.json，私钥 {KEY}（anvil dev key，走环境变量）。
assertions: quote (collateral to lock, principal received, implied APR) was reported before executing the borrow
on-chain borrower position is fully closed: debt=0, collateral=0, withdrawable=0
borrower's WETH balance is fully restored after reclaim (collateral returned to the atom)
the private key never appears as a command-line argument (env var only)
